authorization: Author requested complete visualization with or without LEDs, replacing the N/A panels.
geometric_rule: Using the original integer sphere centroid and pixel radius from the regression loader, choose (cx + sign*2*Rpx, cy); sign points toward the wider horizontal image margin, right on ties. Require an in-image point outside all annotated conductors.
feature_rule: Recompute the nearest-conductor surface distance, sphere-centre distance without an added radius, FEM sample, empirical derivative and normalized image coordinates at each virtual query.
reference_rule: g(query-to-conductor distance) is a model-generated display reference only, not an observation or new regression label.
marker: Black-outlined white cross in both hybrid rows for the five virtual-query examples.
unchanged: Original RGB and latent/PCA pixels, existing valid-query profiles, model weights, regression predictions, scores and timing tables.
